modules.descriptionUz: C1 so'z boyligi — ko'p so'z bilish emas, kerakli so'zni tanlash. Bu modulda B2 va C1 ifodalarini yonma-yon ko'rasiz, umumiy fe'llardan aniq fe'llarga o'tasiz va kollokatsiya aniqligini mustahkamlaysiz.

content.titleUz: Nega aynan shu yerda qotib qolasiz?
content.bodyUz:
B2 (51-64) va C1 (65-75) o'rtasidagi farq — bilgan so'zlaringiz **soni** emas. B2 talaba fikrni **yetkazadi**; C1 talaba fikrni **boshqaradi**.

Baholovchi javobingizni o'qiganda uchta savolga javob izlaydi:

1. Bu odam eng aniq so'zni tanladimi, yoki eng birinchi esiga kelganini ishlatdimi?
2. Bitta fikrni ifodalash uchun qancha so'z sarfladi?
3. Ohangni (rasmiy/norasmiy, qat'iy/ehtiyotkor) o'zi tanladimi, yoki tasodifan shunday chiqdimi?

B2 da uchala savolga javob — «yo'q». C1 da — «ha». Shu kurs aynan mana shu uchta «ha» ni yasaydi.

content.titleUz: C1 ning uch belgisi: aniqlik, zichlik, nazorat
content.bodyUz:
**1. Aniqlik (precision).** *very important* emas — **pivotal**. Bitta so'z uch so'zning ishini bajaradi.

**2. Zichlik (density).** *Because the costs were rising, the company decided to stop hiring* emas — **With costs rising, the company froze recruitment**.

**3. Nazorat (control).** *This is bad* emas — **This is arguably counterproductive**. Siz qanchalik qat'iy gapirayotganingizni o'zingiz belgilaysiz.

Diqqat: uchalasi ham «so'z boyligini ko'rsatish» emas. Ular — fikrni aniqroq yetkazish **vositasi**. Bu farqni unutgan talaba C1 emas, **sun'iy B2** yozadi.

content.titleUz: B2 -> C1: bir xil g'oya, ikki daraja (20 juftlik)
rows: Bitta sifat «very + adjective» ni almashtiradi — kuchaytirgich kerak emas, ma'no so'zning o'zida

«surge» o'zida «tez va katta o'sish» ma'nosini saqlaydi — uch so'z bitta otga siqiladi
Umumiy fe'l o'rniga bitta aniq fe'l — akademik registr belgisi
a very bad effect on health
«detrimental impact» — kuchli kollokatsiya; «bad effect» neytral va zaif
a lot of people think that
there is a widespread belief that
Fikr manbasini shaxssizlashtirish — akademik yozuvda talab qilinadigan ohang
Aniq fe'l + aniq ot: «nimani o'ylash» degan savolga ham javob beradi
«make + adjective» konstruksiyasi B2 belgisi; bitta fe'l C1 belgisi
Bir so'zli diskurs markeri — rasmiy matnda tabiiyroq
Sabab-natijani bir so'zda bog'laydi; «because of this» og'zaki ohangda
it is very difficult to solve
Fikr shunchaki «qiyin» emas — QANDAY qiyinligi aniqlanadi

Takroriy konstruksiya o'rniga aniq miqdoriy ifoda

content.titleUz: Gap darajasida upgrade: oldin va keyin

items.en: B2: Pollution is a very big problem in cities and it causes a lot of health problems. -> C1: Urban pollution poses a serious threat to public health.
items.uz: 20 so'z 9 so'zga siqildi, ma'no esa aniqlashdi. «poses a threat» — xavf haqidagi eng tabiiy juftlik.

items.en: B2: A lot of young people cannot find a job after university. -> C1: Graduate unemployment remains stubbornly high.
items.uz: «Graduate unemployment» — nominal ibora; «stubbornly high» muammoning davomiyligini bir so'zda ko'rsatadi.

items.en: B2: The internet has changed our life very much. -> C1: The internet has fundamentally reshaped daily life.
items.uz: «very much» o'rniga «fundamentally», «changed» o'rniga «reshaped» — ikkalasi ham aniqroq va kuchliroq.

items.en: B2: Governments should do something about climate change. -> C1: Governments must take decisive action on climate change.
items.uz: «do something» — B2 ning eng ko'p uchraydigan bo'shlig'i. «take decisive action» aniq va qat'iy.

items.en: B2: It is not good for children to watch TV a lot. -> C1: Excessive screen time is detrimental to children's development.
items.uz: «not good» — inkor orqali berilgan zaif baho; «detrimental to» to'g'ridan-to'g'ri va aniq.

items.en: B2: Many companies make a lot of money but they do not pay enough tax. -> C1: Highly profitable corporations frequently underpay tax.
items.uz: Ikki gap bittaga birlashdi; «underpay» bitta fe'lda «yetarlicha to'lamaydi» ma'nosini saqlaydi.

content.bodyUz:
**1-xato: ortiqcha upgrade.** Har bir oddiy so'zni «chiroyli» so'zga almashtirsangiz, matn sun'iy chiqadi. *I ameliorated my English* — noto'g'ri. *I improved my English* — to'g'ri. C1 = **kerakli joyda** aniq so'z, hamma joyda kam uchraydigan so'z emas.

**2-xato: registr adashishi.** Speaking da «Consequently, one must ascertain whether...» deb gapirsangiz, baholovchi buni yodlangan matn deb hisoblaydi va ball tushadi. Yozma registr ≠ og'zaki registr.

**3-xato: kollokatsiyani buzish.** *make a research*, *do a mistake*, *say me* — bularni C1 talaba qilmaydi. Bitta buzilgan juftlik butun xatboshi taassurotini yo'q qiladi. (Bu haqda shu modulning 3-darsida batafsil.)

**Baholash mezoni: Lexical Resource.** B2 tavsifi — «umumiy mavzularda yetarli so'z boyligi, ba'zan noaniq so'z tanlash». C1 tavsifi — «so'zni aniq va moslashuvchan tanlaydi, kam uchraydigan iboralarni tabiiy ishlatadi».

Amaliy mezon: yozgan essengizdan 5 ta «very + sifat» va 5 ta «a lot of» ni toping. Har birini bitta aniq so'zga almashtiring. Faqat shu bitta harakat sizni Lexical Resource bo'yicha B2 ning yuqori chegarasidan C1 ga olib chiqadi.

exercises.promptUz: Ajratilgan B2 iborasining eng aniq C1 muqobilini tanlang:

data.text: The new policy had **a very bad effect on** small businesses.

exercises.explanationUz: «detrimental impact on» — akademik matnning standart kuchli juftligi. Qolgan uchtasi shunchaki «very/really» qo'shadi yoki predlogni buzadi («influence to» ✗, «influence on» ✓).

exercises.promptUz: «a lot of problems» ni C1 darajada qanday ifodalaysiz?
exercises.explanationUz: «a host of» — «juda ko'p va turli-tuman» ma'nosini beruvchi C1 iborasi. «a lot of difficulties» faqat otni almashtiradi, konstruksiya B2 darajasida qoladi; qolgan ikkitasi grammatik jihatdan xato.

exercises.promptUz: Rasmiy akademik matnda C1 belgisi bo'lgan variantlarni belgilang (bir nechta):
exercises.explanationUz: «in the end» va «because of this» — og'zaki, ko'p so'zli variantlar. «ultimately» va «consequently» ularning bir so'zli rasmiy muqobili, «an increasing number of» esa «more and more» ning aniq shakli.

exercises.promptUz: Har bir B2 iborasini uning C1 muqobiliga bog'lang:
exercises.explanationUz: To'rttala C1 varianti ham bitta so'zda B2 ning ikki-uch so'zli iborasini qamrab oladi: deteriorate (bosqichma-bosqich yomonlashuv), weigh up (variantlarni taroziga solish), enhance (sifatini oshirish), subsidise (davlat mablag'i bilan qo'llab-quvvatlash).

exercises.promptUz: Bo'sh joyni bitta C1 sifati bilan to'ldiring («hamma joyda mavjud» ma'nosida):

data.text: Smartphones have become ___ in the modern workplace — almost no task is now completed without one.

exercises.explanationUz: «ubiquitous» / «pervasive» — «hamma joyda uchraydigan». Bu bitta sifat «are used a lot everywhere» degan besh so'zni almashtiradi — aynan C1 zichligi.

exercises.promptUz: Ajratilgan umumiy fe'lni aniqroq C1 fe'liga almashtiring (faqat bitta so'z yozing):

data.text: The government introduced strict measures to **stop** the spread of the disease.

exercises.explanationUz: «curb / contain / stem the spread» — kasallik tarqalishi haqidagi standart C1 kollokatsiyalari. «stop» grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin u to'liq to'xtatishni bildiradi; aslida gap cheklash haqida — shuning uchun «curb» aniqroq.

exercises.promptUz: Quyidagi fikr to'g'rimi?

data.statement: C1 darajaga chiqish uchun matndagi har bir oddiy so'zni imkon qadar kam uchraydigan so'z bilan almashtirish kerak.

exercises.explanationUz: Noto'g'ri. Bu «ortiqcha upgrade» xatosi. C1 mezoni — so'zni ANIQ tanlash, kam uchraydigan so'zni ko'rsatish emas. *I ameliorated my English* kabi gaplar ballni ko'taradi emas, tushiradi.

exercises.promptEn:
Rewrite the following B2 paragraph at C1 level (60-90 words). Keep the meaning identical, but remove every 'very', every 'a lot of', and every general verb (get / make / do / have). Use at least three items from the B2 -> C1 table.

'Nowadays a lot of young people move to big cities. This is because there are a lot of jobs there. But it makes a lot of problems, for example the traffic gets very bad and houses become very expensive.'
exercises.promptUz:
Quyidagi B2 xatboshisini C1 darajada qayta yozing (60-90 so'z). Ma'noni aynan saqlang, lekin har bir «very», har bir «a lot of» va har bir umumiy fe'lni (get / make / do / have) olib tashlang. Jadvaldagi kamida uchta B2 -> C1 juftligidan foydalaning.

«Nowadays a lot of young people move to big cities. This is because there are a lot of jobs there. But it makes a lot of problems, for example the traffic gets very bad and houses become very expensive.»

objectivesUz: get / make / do / have o'rniga aniq fe'l tanlashni avtomatlashtirish
Nominalizatsiya orqali ikki-uch gapni bitta zich gapga aylantirish
Nominalizatsiyani qachon ISHLATMASLIK kerakligini bilish

content.titleUz: get, make, do, have — B2 ning to'rt tayanchi
content.bodyUz:
Har qanday B2 matnini oling: fe'llarining qariyb yarmi shu to'rttasi bo'ladi. Sababi oddiy — bu fe'llar **hamma narsaga** yaraydi. Aynan shuning uchun ular hech narsani **aniq** ifodalamaydi.

*I got a job.* — Topdingizmi, yutdingizmi, tasodifanmi? Noma'lum.
*I secured a job.* — Raqobat bor edi va siz uddaladingiz.
*I landed a job.* — Kutilmagan omad (norasmiy).
*I was offered a job.* — Tashabbus ularniki.

Bir xil vaziyat, to'rt xil ma'no. C1 talaba to'rttasidan **keraklisini** tanlaydi; B2 talaba faqat *got* ni biladi. Baholovchi uchun bu farq bir qarashda ko'rinadi.

content.titleUz: B2 -> C1: umumiy fe'ldan aniq fe'lga (18 juftlik)
rows: exert an influence on / have an impact on

content.bodyUz:
Nominalizatsiya — harakatni **ot** ko'rinishida ifodalash. Bu C1 akademik yozuvining asosiy zichlashtirish quroli.

*The government decided to raise taxes. This angered many voters.* (13 so'z, 2 gap)
*The government's decision to raise taxes angered many voters.* (10 so'z, 1 gap)

Nima o'zgardi? Birinchi variantdagi butun harakat ikkinchisida **ega** bo'lib qoldi. Endi unga sifat qo'sha olasiz, uni boshqa gapga ulay olasiz, u haqida gapira olasiz:

*The government's **controversial** decision to raise taxes, **announced without consultation**, angered many voters.*

B2 talaba buni uch gapda aytadi. C1 talaba — bittada, va yo'l-yo'lakay ikkita baho beradi.

content.titleUz: B2 -> C1: fe'lli gapdan nominal iboraga (12 juftlik)
rows: Harakat ega bo'ladi va davom ettiriladi
Boshqa gapga ega yoki to'ldiruvchi bo'lib ulanadi
People are becoming more aware of the issue.
growing public awareness of the issue
He was appointed director, and this surprised everyone.
his appointment as director came as a surprise

items.en: B2: The city built a new metro line. This reduced traffic. People were happy about it.
items.uz: Uchta qisqa gap, uchalasi ham «ega + fe'l + to'ldiruvchi» qolipida. Baholovchi bunday ritmni bir zumda B2 deb belgilaydi.

items.en: C1: The construction of a new metro line significantly reduced congestion, a development warmly welcomed by residents.
items.uz: Nominalizatsiya (the construction of), aniq ot (congestion) va ilova ibora (a development welcomed by...). Bitta gapda uch xil vosita ishlaydi.

items.en: B2: Many people are worried because the price of food is rising. The government did not do anything.
items.uz: Ikki gap, ikkalasi ham bo'sh: «are worried», «did not do anything».

items.en: C1: Rising food prices have provoked widespread public anxiety, compounded by government inaction.
items.uz: «Rising food prices» va «government inaction» — ikkita nominalizatsiya. «did not do anything» bitta otga (inaction) aylandi.

content.bodyUz:
Nominalizatsiya — qurol, dogma emas. Uni noto'g'ri ishlatsangiz, ball tushadi.

**Speaking da ehtiyot bo'ling.** *The implementation of the reduction of expenditure...* — bu og'zaki nutqda tushunarsiz. Gapirganda kuchli fe'l ishlating: *They cut spending, and that backfired.*

**Ketma-ket ikkitadan ko'p nominalizatsiya qilmang.** *The consideration of the implementation of the modification of the policy...* — baholovchi bu gapni ikki marta o'qishga majbur bo'ladi. Bu **Coherence** balini tushiradi, ko'tarmaydi.

**Oltin nisbat:** akademik xatboshida 2-3 ta nominalizatsiya yetarli. Qolgan gaplar kuchli fe'l bilan ishlasin. Zichlik — vosita, maqsad emas.

**Baholash mezoni: Lexical Resource + Grammatical Range.** Nominalizatsiya ikkala mezonga birdan ishlaydi: aniq ot tanlash — leksika, murakkab nominal iborani gapga to'g'ri ulash — grammatika.

Amaliy tekshiruv: essengizni yozib bo'lgach, *get / make / do / have* so'zlarini sanang. Agar ular 250 so'zli matnda 6 martadan ko'p uchrasa, kamida yarmini jadvaldagi aniq fe'lga almashtiring — bu 5 daqiqalik ish, lekin Lexical Resource bo'yicha butun bir pog'ona.

exercises.promptUz: Akademik matn uchun eng to'g'ri fe'lni tanlang:

data.text: The institute has ___ research on air quality for over a decade.

exercises.explanationUz: «conduct research» — akademik ingliz tilining standart juftligi. «make a research» butunlay xato; «do research» og'zaki nutqda qabul qilinadi, lekin yozma imtihonda zaif ko'rinadi.

exercises.promptUz: «Prices increased sharply last year» gapining to'g'ri nominal shaklini tanlang:
exercises.explanationUz: Nominalizatsiyada ravish (sharply) sifatga (sharp) aylanadi, fe'l (increased) otga (increase) aylanadi, predlog esa «in» bo'ladi: an increase IN prices, a decline IN readership, a rise IN temperature.

exercises.promptUz: Umumiy iborani uning aniq C1 muqobiliga bog'lang:
exercises.explanationUz: Har bir aniq fe'l qo'shimcha ma'no olib keladi: reach (muhokamadan keyin), convene (rasmiy chaqirish), fund (moliyalashtirish), exert (ta'sir o'tkazish).

exercises.promptUz: Bo'sh joyni «make» dan ko'ra aniqroq fe'l bilan to'ldiring:

data.text: After months of negotiation, the two sides finally ___ an agreement.

exercises.explanationUz: «reach an agreement» — muzokara natijasini bildiruvchi standart kollokatsiya. «make an agreement» grammatik jihatdan mumkin, lekin muzokara konteksti uchun «reach» ancha tabiiy va C1 darajaga mos.

exercises.promptUz: Nominalizatsiyani to'ldiring (fe'l «decided» dan yasalgan ot):

data.text: The government's ___ to cut fuel subsidies provoked nationwide protests.

exercises.explanationUz: «The government decided to...» -> «The government's decision to...». Fe'l otga aylandi va endi u gapning egasi bo'lib, o'ziga sifat va ergash gap qabul qila oladi.

exercises.promptUz: Quyidagi gapni uch so'zli nominal iboraga aylantiring:

data.text: The population is growing rapidly. -> ___ (3 so'z)

exercises.explanationUz: rapidly -> rapid (ravish sifatga), is growing -> growth (fe'l otga), population esa aniqlovchi ot bo'lib qoladi: rapid population growth. Bu qolip juda mahsuldor: rapid technological development, sharp price increase, growing public awareness.

exercises.promptUz: Bo'laklardan zich C1 gapini tuzing:

items: a development welcomed by local residents
The construction of a new metro line
traffic congestion in the city centre,

order: The construction of a new metro line
traffic congestion in the city centre,
a development welcomed by local residents

exercises.explanationUz: Nominalizatsiya (The construction of...) ega bo'ladi, keyin fe'l va to'ldiruvchi keladi, oxirida esa butun gapga izoh beruvchi ilova ibora (a development welcomed by...) turadi.

exercises.promptUz: Quyidagi fikr to'g'rimi?

data.statement: Speaking Part 3 da imkon qadar ko'p nominalizatsiya ishlatish C1 ball keltiradi.

exercises.explanationUz: Noto'g'ri. Og'zaki nutqda zich nominal iboralar tushunarsiz va sun'iy eshitiladi — baholovchi buni yodlangan matn deb baholaydi. Gapirganda kuchli fe'l ishlating, nominalizatsiyani esa yozma matnga qoldiring.

lessons.titleUz: Kollokatsiya aniqligi: C1 xatosi boshqacha bo'ladi
objectivesUz: C1 darajadagi xato turini tanib olish: grammatika emas, noto'g'ri so'z juftligi
Eng ko'p buziladigan 28 ta kollokatsiyani to'g'ri shaklda o'zlashtirish
Zaif lekin to'g'ri juftlikni kuchli C1 juftligiga ko'tarish

content.bodyUz:
A2 da xato — *He go to school*.
B1 da xato — *I am agree with you*.
B2 da xato — *I have visited Samarkand last year*.

C1 chegarasida esa grammatikangiz allaqachon to'g'ri. Endi xato butunlay boshqa joyda: **so'zlar bir-biriga to'g'ri kelmaydi**.

*I made a research about pollution.*

Bu gapda birorta grammatik xato yo'q. Zamon to'g'ri, artikl to'g'ri, so'z tartibi to'g'ri. Lekin ingliz tilida so'zlashuvchi buni **hech qachon** aytmaydi. To'g'risi: *I conducted research on pollution.*

Baholovchi buni darhol payqaydi va Lexical Resource ni C1 dan B2 ga tushiradi. Sababi C1 tavsifida aynan shunday yozilgan: «kollokatsiyalarni tabiiy va aniq ishlatadi».

**1. Fe'l + ot:** conduct research, meet a deadline, raise awareness, pose a threat, draw a conclusion
**2. Sifat + ot:** heavy traffic, a strong argument, a widespread belief, a pressing concern
**3. Ravish + sifat:** highly effective, deeply concerned, bitterly disappointed, widely regarded
**4. Fe'l + predlog:** result in, account for, contribute to, refrain from, comply with

B2 talaba asosan to'rtinchi turda xato qiladi (*discuss about*, *depend of*). C1 chegarasidagi talaba esa **birinchi va uchinchi** turda qoqiladi: *do a mistake* o'rniga *make a mistake*, *very concerned* o'rniga *deeply concerned*.

Diqqat: uchinchi turdagi xato «xato» ham emas — shunchaki zaif. Aynan shu zaiflik B2 va C1 orasidagi chegarani belgilaydi.

rows: Jinoyat, xato va o'z joniga qasd — «commit»
take a risk / run a risk
make a suggestion / put forward a proposal
reach a conclusion / draw a conclusion
reap the benefits of / derive benefit from
pose a problem / pose a threat
Bitta ibora butun ma'noni qamrab oladi

content.titleUz: Bitta buzilgan juftlik butun xatboshini yiqitadi

items.en: ✗ Many researchers have made a research about this topic and did important discoveries.
items.uz: Grammatika benuqson, lekin ikkita buzilgan juftlik bor: «made a research» va «did discoveries». Baholovchi uchun bu — B2.

items.en: ✓ Many researchers have conducted research on this topic and made important discoveries.
items.uz: Bir xil gap, bir xil so'zlar — faqat juftliklar to'g'rilandi. Endi bu C1.

items.en: ✗ The pandemic gave a big problem for schools and had a bad impact to students.
items.uz: «gave a problem» va «impact to» — ikkalasi ham buzilgan. Predlog xatosi (to/on) ayniqsa ko'zga tashlanadi.

items.en: ✓ The pandemic posed a serious problem for schools and had a detrimental impact on students.
items.uz: pose a problem, a detrimental impact ON — ikkita to'g'ri juftlik butun gapning darajasini ko'taradi.

content.bodyUz:
**Yolg'iz so'z yodlamang — juftlik yodlang.** «Threat» so'zining tarjimasini bilish foydasiz. Foydalisi: *pose a threat / a serious threat / under threat / a threat to*.

**Uch ustunli daftar yuriting:** [FE'L yoki SIFAT] + [OT] + [o'zingiz yozgan misol gap]. Haftasiga 15 juftlik — bu yiliga 780 ta juftlik.

**10 soniyalik tekshiruv:** iborani qo'shtirnoq ichida qidiring. «conduct research» — millionlab natija; «make a research» — deyarli yo'q yoki faqat xato manbalarda. Shu oddiy test sizni o'nlab xatolardan saqlaydi.

**Eng muhimi:** kollokatsiyalarni tayyor ro'yxatdan emas, **o'z matningizdan** yig'ing. Boshqalarning xatosi emas, sizniki takrorlanadi. (Bu haqda 4-modulning 3-darsida to'liq metodika bor.)

**Baholash mezoni: Lexical Resource — «uses collocation naturally».** Amaliy hisob: baholovchi bitta buzilgan kollokatsiyani kechiradi; ikkitasi — shubha uyg'otadi; uchtasi — bal B2 ga tushadi.

Imtihon oldidan oxirgi hafta yangi so'z o'rganmang. O'zingiz allaqachon biladigan 50 ta so'zning **to'g'ri juftliklarini** mustahkamlang. Bu yangi 200 ta so'z yodlashdan ko'ra ancha ko'proq ball keltiradi — chunki baholovchi siz bilmagan so'zni ko'ra olmaydi, lekin buzilgan juftlikni albatta ko'radi.

exercises.promptUz: To'g'ri kollokatsiyani tanlang:

data.text: The team ___ a series of experiments to test the hypothesis.

exercises.explanationUz: «carry out an experiment / research / a study» — akademik matnning standart juftligi. «make an experiment» buzilgan kollokatsiya, «take out» esa butunlay boshqa ma'no (chiqarib olmoq).

exercises.promptUz: Qaysi juftlik TABIIY emas?

objectivesUz: Inkor-cheklov inversiyasini xatosiz yasash (Not only, Rarely, Under no circumstances, Only after)

content.bodyUz:
C1 grammatika tavsifi shunday yozilgan: «a wide range of complex structures used with **flexibility**» — murakkab tuzilmalarning keng doirasi, **moslashuvchan** ishlatilgan.

Diqqat: «keng doira» emas, «moslashuvchan» so'zi kalit. Baholovchi sizda murakkab tuzilma borligini emas, uni **kerakli joyda** ishlatganingizni tekshiradi.

Inversiya — bu bo'yicha eng ko'rinadigan belgi. Sababi: inversiya faqat siz biror fikrni **maxsus ta'kidlamoqchi** bo'lganingizda ishlatiladi. Agar u tasodifiy joyda tursa, baholovchi darhol tushunadi: bu yodlangan.

Shuning uchun bu darsda ikkita narsani birga o'rganamiz — **qanday yasash** va **qayerga qo'yish**.

content.bodyUz:
**Qadam 1.** Gap boshiga inkor yoki cheklov ma'nosidagi ibora qo'yiladi:
*Not only, Never, Rarely, Seldom, Little, Hardly ... when, No sooner ... than, Under no circumstances, At no point, On no account, Not until, Only after / when / by / if*

**Qadam 2.** Keyin **savol tartibi** keladi: yordamchi fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l.
*Rarely **have I** seen...* / *Never **had she** imagined...*

**Qadam 3.** Agar yordamchi fe'l yo'q bo'lsa, **do / does / did** qo'shiladi:
✗ *Rarely he complains.* → ✓ *Rarely **does he** complain.*
✗ *Only then I understood.* → ✓ *Only then **did I** understand.*

**Muhim nozik nuqta:** «Only when / Only after» bilan boshlanganda inversiya **ergash gapda emas, bosh gapda** bo'ladi:
✓ *Only when the results arrived **did we realise** how serious it was.*
✗ *Only when **did the results arrive**, we realised...*

**Bitta essede maksimum 2 ta inversiya.** Uchtadan ko'p bo'lsa, baholovchi yodlangan qolipni ko'radi va Grammatical Range balini oshirmaydi.

**Faqat haqiqatan urg'u kerak bo'lgan joyda.** Odatda ikki joy ideal: (1) kirish qismida tezisni e'lon qilganda, (2) asosiy qismda qarshi fikrni rad etganda.

**Speaking da yanada tejamkor bo'ling.** Part 3 da butun suhbat davomida bitta *Not only...* tabiiy eshitiladi. Har javobda ishlatsangiz — sun'iy.

**Yarim eslangan struktura — xato.** Bu eng ko'p uchraydigan holat:
✗ *Not only I think that...* (yordamchi fe'l yo'q)
✗ *Rarely, I go to the cinema.* (vergul qo'yilgan, inversiya yo'q)
✗ *Never I have seen...*

Bunday gap ballni ko'tarmaydi — **tushiradi**, chunki u aniqlik (accuracy) xatosi sifatida hisoblanadi. Qoida oddiy: ishonchingiz komil bo'lmasa, oddiy gap yozing.

content.bodyUz:
Inversiya — bitta qurol. Ikkinchisi — **cleft** (gapni ikkiga «yorish»). U inversiyadan xavfsizroq, chunki xato qilish qiyinroq.

**It-cleft:** *It is **X** that/who ...*
*It is poor management, not a lack of funding, that lies behind the failure.*

**Pseudo-cleft (wh-cleft):** *What ... is/was **X***
*What the system needs is transparency, not more regulation.*

**All-cleft:** *All (that) ... is **X***
*All they need is a clear timetable.*

Cleft ning kuchi shundaki, u nafaqat urg'u beradi, balki **qarama-qarshilik** o'rnatadi: X, Y emas. Bu esa argumentli essede aynan kerak bo'ladigan narsa.

**Baholash mezoni: Grammatical Range and Accuracy.** Bu mezon ikki qismdan iborat — doira VA aniqlik. Inversiya doirani kengaytiradi, lekin xato qilsangiz aniqlikni buzadi, ya'ni bir qo'lingiz bilan bergan ballni ikkinchi qo'lingiz bilan olib qo'yasiz.

Imtihon strategiyasi: essengizga **oldindan tayyorlangan ikkita** tuzilmani joylang — bitta inversiya (kirish yoki qarshi fikr qismida) va bitta cleft (xulosada). Ikkalasini uyda 20 marta mashq qiling. Imtihonda o'ylab o'tirmaysiz, lekin baholovchi C1 belgisini ko'radi.

exercises.promptUz: To'g'ri inversiyani tanlang:

exercises.explanationUz: Cheklov ravishi (Rarely) gap boshiga chiqqach, savol tartibi kerak: yordamchi fe'l (have) + ega (I) + asosiy fe'l (seen). «Rarely I have seen» — inversiyasiz, ya'ni xato.

exercises.promptUz: Bo'sh joyni to'ldiring:

data.text: Not only ___ the policy extremely expensive, but it also failed to reduce congestion.

exercises.explanationUz: «Not only» dan keyin yordamchi fe'l egadan OLDIN keladi: Not only WAS the policy... Agar «it was» yozsangiz, inversiya yo'qoladi va tuzilma xato bo'ladi.

exercises.promptUz: Bo'sh joyni modal fe'l bilan to'ldiring:

data.text: Under no circumstances ___ candidates be allowed to bring mobile phones into the examination hall.

exercises.explanationUz: «Under no circumstances» — inkor ma'nosidagi ibora, shuning uchun undan keyin modal fe'l egadan oldin turadi: should candidates be allowed. Bu — rasmiy qoidalar tilining tipik tuzilmasi.

exercises.promptUz: Shartli gapni «if» siz, inversiya bilan to'ldiring:

data.text: ___ I known about the deadline earlier, I would have submitted the report on time.

exercises.explanationUz: Third conditional da «If I had known» -> «Had I known». «if» tushadi va «had» gap boshiga chiqadi. Bu rasmiy yozma uslubning kuchli C1 belgisi.

exercises.promptUz: Bo'laklardan to'g'ri inversiyali gap tuzing:

items: Only after the protests had spread nationwide

order: Only after the protests had spread nationwide

exercises.explanationUz: «Only after ...» bilan boshlanganda inversiya ERGASH gapda emas, BOSH gapda bo'ladi: ergash gap normal tartibda (the protests had spread), bosh gap esa inversiyada (did the government agree).

lessons.titleUz: Gaplarni zichlashtirish: participle va absolute clause
objectivesUz: Uch xil participle clause ni (V-ing, having + V3, V3) to'g'ri yasash
Absolute clause (With costs rising, ...) bilan ikki gapni bittaga birlashtirish
Dangling modifier xatosini tanib olish va oldini olish

content.bodyUz:
B2 talabaning yozuvi qanday ko'rinadi? Uchta mustaqil gap, «and», «because», «so» bilan ulangan:

*The board studied the data. Then they rejected the proposal. This surprised the shareholders.*

C1 talabaning yozuvi: bitta **bosh gap** va uning atrofida aylanuvchi ikkita **yordamchi tuzilma**:

*Having studied the data, the board rejected the proposal, a decision that took shareholders by surprise.*

So'zlar soni deyarli bir xil (15 va 17), lekin farq katta. Birinchi variantda uchta teng huquqli gap bor — o'quvchi qaysi biri asosiy ekanini bilmaydi. Ikkinchisida esa **ierarxiya** bor: asosiy voqea — taklifning rad etilishi; qolgani unga izoh.

Baholovchi aynan shu ierarxiyani qidiradi. C1 tavsifida bu «information is organised and signposted» deb yozilgan.

**1. -ing (present participle)** — bir vaqtda sodir bo'ladigan yoki sabab bo'luvchi harakat, aniq nisbat:
*Realising that the deadline had passed, she called the office immediately.*
*Acting on legal advice, the company withdrew the product.*

**2. having + V3 (perfect participle)** — oldinroq tugagan harakat:
*Having considered all the options, the board approved the merger.*
*Having been rejected twice, he decided to apply elsewhere.* (majhul shakl)

**3. V3 (past participle)** — majhul nisbat:
*Written in 1890, the novel still feels startlingly modern.*
*Faced with mounting criticism, the minister resigned.*

**Temir qoida:** participle clause ning **yashirin egasi** bosh gapning egasi bilan **bir xil** bo'lishi shart.
✓ *Having finished the report, **I** noticed that the printer had broken.* (men tugatdim, men payqadim)
✗ *Having finished the report, **the printer** broke down.* (printer hisobotni tugatmagan!)

Participle clause da ega yashirin bo'ladi. **Absolute clause** da esa ega **ochiq aytiladi** — va aynan shuning uchun u bosh gap egasidan **farq qilishi mumkin**.

**Eng ishlatiladigan shakl: with + ot + -ing / -ed**
*With costs rising and demand falling, the airline suspended half of its routes.*
*With no budget left, the project was quietly cancelled.*

**«with» siz shakl (yanada rasmiy):**
*Costs rising sharply, the airline suspended half of its routes.*
*The negotiations having collapsed, both sides returned to court.*

**Nima uchun bu C1 quroli?** Chunki u sizga sabab, shart yoki fon ma'lumotini **butun bir ergash gap yozmasdan** berish imkonini beradi. «Because costs were rising and demand was falling» — 9 so'z. «With costs rising and demand falling» — 6 so'z, va u bosh gapga bo'ysunadi, u bilan raqobatlashmaydi.

**Ogohlantirish:** bitta gapda ikkitadan ko'p absolute clause ishlatmang. Aks holda gap markazini yo'qotadi.

Seeing the results, she changed her method.

Passed in 2019, the law remains deeply controversial.

With costs rising, firms are cutting staff.

The talks having failed, both sides returned to court.
If we assume that the data is accurate, the trend is clear.
Assuming the data is accurate, the trend is unmistakable.
Although he was warned several times, he ignored the rules.
Warned several times, he nonetheless ignored the rules.
The report was published last week and it caused a scandal.
Published last week, the report triggered a political scandal.

With no budget left, the project was quietly cancelled.
He finished his degree and then he moved abroad.
Having finished his degree, he moved abroad.

content.titleUz: Eng ko'p uchraydigan xato: dangling modifier
content.bodyUz:
«Dangling modifier» — egasi bosh gapga to'g'ri kelmaydigan participle clause. Bu C1 chegarasidagi talabalarning **birinchi raqamli** grammatik xatosi, chunki tuzilma to'g'ri, lekin mantiq buzilgan.

✗ *Walking through the park, the trees looked beautiful.*
(Daraxtlar parkda sayr qilyaptimi?)
✓ *Walking through the park, **I** thought the trees looked beautiful.*

✗ *Having lived in London for years, the accent was easy to understand.*
(Aksent Londonda yashaganmi?)
✓ *Having lived in London for years, **she** found the accent easy to understand.*

✗ *Being underfunded, the government closed several clinics.*
(Hukumat moliyalanmaganmi yoki klinikalarmi?)
✓ ***Underfunded** for years, several clinics were closed.*

**30 soniyalik tekshiruv:** participle clause yozganingizdan keyin bosh gapning egasini toping va o'zingizga savol bering: «Bu ega chindan ham shu harakatni bajarganmi?» Agar javob «yo'q» bo'lsa — yoki egani almashtiring, yoki absolute clause ga o'ting (with + ot + ...).

content.titleUz: Bir xatboshi: B2 va C1 varianti

items.en: B2: The company lost money for three years. So it decided to close 20 shops. This made 400 people lose their jobs. The unions were angry about this.
items.uz: To'rt gap, to'rttasi ham qisqa va teng. «So», «this» bilan ulangan — B2 ritmi.

items.en: C1: Having posted losses for three consecutive years, the company closed 20 outlets, a decision that cost 400 jobs and provoked fierce union opposition.
items.uz: Perfect participle (Having posted...) + bosh gap + ilova ibora (a decision that...). To'rt gap bittaga siqildi, lekin hech qanday ma'lumot yo'qolmadi.

items.en: C1 (variant): With losses mounting for a third year, the company closed 20 outlets — a move that cost 400 jobs and drew fierce criticism from unions.
items.uz: Xuddi shu ma'no absolute clause bilan. «With + ot + -ing» varianti ko'proq fon-sabab ohangini beradi.

content.bodyUz:
**Baholash mezoni: Grammatical Range and Accuracy + Coherence and Cohesion.** Participle clause ikkala mezonga ishlaydi: u murakkab tuzilma sifatida doirani kengaytiradi va ayni paytda gaplar orasidagi mantiqiy bog'lanishni bog'lovchisiz ko'rsatadi.

Imtihon amaliyoti: 250 so'zli essede **2-3 ta** participle yoki absolute clause yetarli. Ideal joylashuv — har bir asosiy xatboshining birinchi yoki oxirgi gapida. Lekin har bir yozganingizdan keyin dangling tekshiruvini o'tkazing: agar ega mos kelmasa, bu ball qo'shmaydi, aksincha aniqlik xatosi sifatida qayd etiladi.

exercises.promptUz: Bo'sh joyni to'ldiring:

data.text: ___ all the available evidence, the committee dismissed the complaint as unfounded.

exercises.explanationUz: Ko'rib chiqish rad etishdan OLDIN sodir bo'lgan, shuning uchun perfect participle (having + V3) kerak. «Being reviewed» majhul shakl bo'lib, qo'mita ko'rib chiqilgan degan ma'no beradi — bu mantiqan noto'g'ri.

exercises.promptUz: Qaysi gapda dangling modifier xatosi bor?

options: Having read the article, its conclusion seemed weak to me.
Having read the article, I found its conclusion weak.
Written in haste, the email contained several errors.
With prices falling, consumers began to spend again.

answer.value: Having read the article, its conclusion seemed weak to me.

exercises.explanationUz: Bosh gapning egasi «its conclusion» — lekin maqolani xulosa o'qimagan, balki men o'qiganman. Ega mos kelmagani uchun bu dangling modifier. To'g'ri variant: «Having read the article, I found its conclusion weak.»

exercises.promptUz: Absolute clause ni to'ldiring (bitta so'z):

data.text: ___ costs rising and passenger numbers falling, the airline suspended half of its routes.

exercises.explanationUz: «With + ot + -ing» — absolute clause ning eng ishlatiladigan shakli. U «Because costs were rising and passenger numbers were falling» degan uzun ergash gapni olti so'zga siqadi.

exercises.promptUz: Past participle bilan to'ldiring:

data.text: ___ in 1998, the treaty is now widely regarded as a turning point in the region's history.

exercises.explanationUz: Shartnoma imzolanadi (majhul), shuning uchun V3 shakli kerak: Signed in 1998 = Because it was signed in 1998. Bu «The treaty was signed in 1998 and it is now regarded...» degan ikki gapni bittaga birlashtiradi.

exercises.explanationUz: Perfect participle clause oldin keladi (avvalgi harakat), keyin bosh gap (ega + fe'l + to'ldiruvchi), oxirida holat ibora. Ega mos: kengash risklarni tortdi va kengash tasdiqladi — dangling xatosi yo'q.

exercises.promptUz: Har bir B2 ergash gapini uning zichlashtirilgan C1 shakliga bog'lang:

left: Because he had finished his degree, ...

exercises.explanationUz: Har bir bog'lovchi o'ziga xos participle shakliga aylanadi: «because he had» -> having + V3; «although it was written» -> V3; «because costs are» (ega boshqa) -> with + ot + -ing; «when she saw» (ega bir xil) -> -ing.

data.statement: Participle clause ning yashirin egasi bosh gapning egasi bilan bir xil bo'lishi shart.

exercises.explanationUz: To'g'ri. Bu qoida buzilsa dangling modifier xatosi yuzaga keladi. Agar ega boshqa bo'lishi kerak bo'lsa, participle clause emas, absolute clause ishlating: «With costs rising, the firm cut staff» — bu yerda ega ochiq aytilgani uchun farq qilishi mumkin.

content.bodyUz:
**1. Modal fe'llar:** may, might, could, would, may well, would appear to
*Higher taxes **may** discourage investment.*

**2. Fe'llar:** appear to, seem to, suggest, indicate, imply, be thought to, tend to
*The data **suggests** a correlation rather than a cause.*

**3. Ravishlar:** arguably, apparently, seemingly, largely, broadly, relatively, to some extent, in part
*The policy was **largely** successful.*

**4. Miqdor va chegara:** many, most, a significant proportion, in most cases, particularly in developed countries, at least in the short term
*In most industrialised countries, the trend is clear.*

**Qora ro'yxat:** *all, every, always, never, nobody, everyone, completely, totally* — bu so'zlarni faqat siz ularni isbotlay olsangiz ishlating. Aks holda ular Task Response balini tushiradi.

Agar faqat hedging ishlatsangiz, matn **ishonchsiz** bo'ladi — bu ham C1 emas. Baholovchi «bu odam o'z pozitsiyasini bilmaydi» deb yozadi.

C1 talaba **o'z tezisida** kuchli gapiradi, **dalillarda** ehtiyotkor bo'ladi.

**Booster arsenali:** clearly, undoubtedly, undeniably, invariably, without question, overwhelmingly, there is little doubt that, it is beyond dispute that, all the evidence points to

**Oltin ritm (essede):**
- Kirish tezisi → **booster**: *There is little doubt that urban air quality has become a public health emergency.*
- Asosiy dalillar → **hedge**: *This may partly explain the sharp rise in childhood asthma.*
- Qarshi fikr → **hedge**: *Critics arguably overstate the economic cost.*
- Xulosa → **booster**: *The evidence points overwhelmingly towards stricter regulation.*

Agar teskarisini qilsangiz — tezisda «maybe», dalilda «definitely» — baholovchi mantiqiy nomuvofiqlikni ko'radi va Coherence bali tushadi.

content.titleUz: Takrorlanish — B2 ning eng ko'rinadigan imzosi
content.bodyUz:
Baholovchi matningizni o'qiyotganda bir narsani beixtiyor sanaydi: bir xil so'z necha marta qaytdi.

*The government introduced a carbon tax. The carbon tax was very unpopular. Many people protested against the carbon tax.*

Bu gaplarda grammatik xato yo'q. Lekin «carbon tax» uch marta qaytdi va matn bir joyda depsinayotgandek tuyuladi. Coherence and Cohesion bo'yicha bu — aniq B2.

C1 varianti:

*The government introduced a carbon tax. **This measure** proved deeply unpopular, **provoking** protests in a dozen cities.*

Nima o'zgardi? «The carbon tax» o'rniga «this measure» keldi — va bu shunchaki sinonim emas. «Measure» so'zi soliqni **tasniflaydi**: bu chora ekan. Ya'ni siz takrorni yo'q qilib, bir vaqtda **yangi ma'lumot** qo'shdingiz.

Mana shu — C1 referencing ning butun mohiyati: **takrorlamang, umumlashtiring va baho bering.**

**1. this / these / such + umumlashtiruvchi ot**
Oldingi gapning butun mazmunini bitta ot ostiga yig'adi:
*...prices rose by 40%. **This increase** hit low-income families hardest.*
*...they cut wages and froze hiring. **Such measures** rarely improve morale.*

**2. the former / the latter**
Ikki narsa aytilgandan keyin ularni qayta yozmaslik uchun:
*We can expand the road network or improve public transport. **The former** is expensive; **the latter** is far more sustainable.*

**3. do so / doing so / do this**
Butun fe'l bandini almashtiradi:
*Companies should reduce packaging waste; **in doing so**, they also cut costs.*

**4. one / ones va ellipsis**
Otni yoki gap bo'lagini tushirib qoldirish:
*I have an old laptop and I want a new **one**.*
*Some students prefer group work; **others** prefer working alone.* (students takrorlanmaydi)
*He said he would resign, and he duly **did**.* (resign takrorlanmaydi)

content.titleUz: Xavfli «this»: eng ko'p uchraydigan cohesion xatosi
content.bodyUz:
Yolg'iz «this» yoki «it» — noaniqlik manbayi. Bu Coherence and Cohesion balini tushiradigan asosiy sabab.

✗ *The company cut wages and the union called a strike. **This** damaged the firm's reputation.*

Savol: nima zarar yetkazdi — maosh kesilishimi, ish tashlashmi, yoki ikkalasimi? O'quvchi bilmaydi. Baholovchi buni «unclear reference» deb belgilaydi.

✓ *The company cut wages and the union called a strike. **This dispute** damaged the firm's reputation.*
✓ *...**The stoppage** cost the firm an estimated $2m.*

**Temir qoida:** rasmiy yozuvda **hech qachon yolg'iz «this» bilan gap boshlamang**. Har doim ot qo'shing: this measure, this shift, this reluctance, this discrepancy.

Bu bitta qoida — imtihon yozuvida eng arzon ball. Uni bajarish uchun yangi so'z ham, yangi grammatika ham kerak emas.

**Baholash mezoni: Coherence and Cohesion.** C1 tavsifi: «uses cohesion in such a way that it attracts no attention» — bog'lanish shu qadar tabiiyki, u **e'tiborni tortmaydi**.

Bu jumlani diqqat bilan o'qing: baholovchi bog'lovchini ko'rmasligi kerak. «Moreover... Furthermore... In addition...» ketma-ket kelsa, u ko'rinadi — bu B2. «This measure... The former... in doing so...» ko'rinmaydi — bu C1.

Amaliy tekshiruv: essengizdagi har bir «this» va «it» ni toping. Har birining oldiga aniq ot qo'yish mumkinmi? Agar ha — qo'ying.

exercises.explanationUz: «The former» — birinchi aytilgani (raise taxes), «the latter» — oxirgi aytilgani (cut spending). Tartib qat'iy: former har doim birinchi, latter har doim ikkinchi.

Kuchli topic sentence yozish: da'vo + boshqaruvchi g'oya

content.bodyUz:
Baholovchi sizning essengizni 3-4 daqiqada o'qiydi. U har bir gapni bir xil diqqat bilan o'qimaydi — u **xatboshilarning birinchi gaplarini** o'qib, matn tuzilishini bir zumda tushunishga harakat qiladi.

Agar birinchi gaplar sizning argumentingiz skeletini bersa, baholovchi «bu odam matnni boshqaryapti» deb xulosa qiladi.
Agar birinchi gaplar fakt yoki misol bo'lsa, u skeletni topa olmaydi — va Coherence bali tushadi.

B2 talaba xatboshini shunday boshlaydi: *For example, in my country many students study abroad.*
C1 talaba shunday boshlaydi: *The most compelling argument for studying abroad is economic rather than academic.*

Birinchisi — misol. Ikkinchisi — **da'vo**. Va da'vodan keyin misol keladi, aksincha emas.

**T — Topic sentence (da'vo).** Xatboshining butun mazmunini bitta gapda e'lon qiladi. Fakt emas, savol emas, misol emas — **da'vo**.
*The most compelling argument for free university education is economic rather than moral.*

**D — Development (kengaytirish).** Da'voni tushuntiradi: nima uchun shunday? Mexanizmni ko'rsatadi.
*Graduates earn more, pay more tax over a lifetime, and are less likely to rely on state support, which means the initial outlay is recovered several times over.*

**E — Exemplification (misol yoki dalil).** Aniq holat, raqam yoki qiyoslash.
*Germany, which abolished tuition fees in 2014, has seen no decline in the quality of its universities and a measurable rise in graduate numbers.*

**L — Link (bog'lash).** Xatboshini yakunlaydi va keyingisiga ko'prik tashlaydi.
*The financial case, then, is stronger than critics allow — though it rests on one assumption that deserves closer scrutiny.*

Uzunlik: 4-6 gap, 70-100 so'z. Ikkita asosiy xatboshi — 250 so'zli essening yuragi.

content.titleUz: B2 -> C1: bir xatboshining har bosqichi
rows: «Firstly, education is very important for our future.»
«The strongest case for public investment in education is economic rather than moral.»
«If we study, we can get a good job and earn money.»
«Graduates pay more tax over a lifetime and draw less on state support, which means the initial outlay is recovered several times over.»
«For example, my brother studied IT and now he has a good salary.»
«Germany, which abolished tuition fees in 2014, has seen a measurable rise in graduate numbers with no decline in standards.»
«The financial case, then, is stronger than critics allow — though it rests on one assumption worth examining.» (keyingi xatboshiga ko'prik)

content.bodyUz:
Topic sentence da ikkita element bo'lishi shart:

**1. Mavzu (topic)** — nima haqida gapiryapsiz.
**2. Boshqaruvchi g'oya (controlling idea)** — bu mavzu haqida nima **da'vo** qilyapsiz.

*The strongest case for public investment in education* [mavzu] *is economic rather than moral* [boshqaruvchi g'oya].

**Uchta yomon topic sentence:**

✗ *Education is important.* — Da'vo yo'q, hech kim buni inkor qilmaydi.
✗ *In this paragraph I will talk about education.* — Meta-izoh; imtihonda ball tushiradi.
✗ *In 2014 Germany abolished tuition fees.* — Bu fakt, da'vo emas. Faktlar E bosqichida keladi.

**Tekshiruv savoli:** «Bu gap bilan kimdir bahslasha oladimi?» Agar **yo'q** bo'lsa, bu topic sentence emas. Agar **ha** bo'lsa — kerakli gap topildi.

**Zaxira qolip:** *The most/least [sifat] aspect of X is Y rather than Z.* — Bu qolip sizga avtomatik ravishda bahsli da'vo yasaydi.

items.en: [T] Remote work has been sold as a lifestyle improvement, but its most significant effect has been on urban economies rather than on individual wellbeing.
items.uz: Topic sentence: da'vo + qarama-qarshilik (X emas, Y). Bahslashish mumkin — demak, kuchli.

items.en: [D] When several hundred thousand office workers stop commuting, the small businesses that depend on their daily spending — cafes, dry cleaners, sandwich shops — lose their entire customer base almost overnight.
items.uz: Development: mexanizmni ko'rsatadi. «Nega shunday?» degan savolga javob beradi.

items.en: [E] In central London, footfall in 2023 remained roughly a fifth below pre-pandemic levels, and a comparable pattern has been recorded in Manhattan and central Tokyo.
items.uz: Exemplification: aniq raqam va uchta shahar. Umumiy «for example» emas — tekshiriladigan dalil.

items.en: [L] The costs of remote work, then, fall largely on people who never had the option of working remotely in the first place — a point its advocates rarely address.

content.bodyUz:
Ko'pchilik xatboshini shunchaki topic sentence ni takrorlab yakunlaydi: *So, as I said, education is very important.* Bu — bo'sh gap, u ball qo'shmaydi.

C1 da uch xil link ishlaydi:

**1. Baholovchi link** — da'voning kuchini o'lchaydi:
*The financial case, then, is stronger than critics allow.*

**2. Oldinga ko'prik** — keyingi xatboshini e'lon qiladi:
*This assumption, however, only holds while unemployment remains low.*

**3. Chegaralovchi link** — da'voning chegarasini belgilaydi:
*This applies, of course, only to countries with an established tax base.*

Uchalasi ham bir vaqtda ikkita ishni bajaradi: xatboshini yopadi va matnni oldinga suradi. Aynan shu narsa Coherence and Cohesion bo'yicha C1 belgisi hisoblanadi.

**Baholash mezoni: Coherence and Cohesion — «presents a clear central topic within each paragraph».** Bu jumla to'g'ridan-to'g'ri topic sentence haqida.

Imtihonda 30 soniyalik tekshiruv: yozib bo'lgach, faqat xatboshilarning **birinchi gaplarini** ketma-ket o'qing. Agar shu 3-4 gap o'zi mustaqil, mantiqiy argument hosil qilsa — tuzilma C1 darajada. Agar ular fakt yoki misol bo'lsa — birinchi gaplarni qayta yozing. Bu butun essede eng yuqori foyda beradigan tuzatish.

exercises.explanationUz: Faqat birinchi variantda da'vo (bahslashish mumkin) va boshqaruvchi g'oya (economic, not practical) bor. Ikkinchisi — meta-izoh, uchinchisi — fakt (E bosqichiga tegishli), to'rtinchisi — hech kim inkor qilmaydigan umumiy gap.

exercises.promptEn: Write ONE body paragraph (90-120 words) on this statement: 'Public transport should be free in all large cities.' Follow T-D-E-L strictly: (T) an arguable topic sentence containing a claim and a controlling idea; (D) two sentences explaining the mechanism behind your claim; (E) one concrete example, figure or comparison; (L) a link sentence that evaluates the claim and points forward to the next paragraph. Do not begin with 'Firstly' or 'In this paragraph'.
exercises.promptUz: Quyidagi mavzu bo'yicha BITTA asosiy xatboshi yozing (90-120 so'z): «Barcha yirik shaharlarda jamoat transporti bepul bo'lishi kerak.» T-D-E-L ni qat'iy bajaring: (T) bahslashish mumkin bo'lgan topic sentence — da'vo va boshqaruvchi g'oya bilan; (D) da'vo mexanizmini tushuntiruvchi ikki gap; (E) bitta aniq misol, raqam yoki qiyoslash; (L) da'voni baholovchi va keyingi xatboshiga ko'prik tashlovchi link gap. «Firstly» yoki «In this paragraph» bilan boshlamang.

lessons.titleUz: Bog'lovchidan tashqari bog'lanish: leksik zanjir, parallellik, ma'lumot oqimi
objectivesUz: Leksik zanjir orqali mavzu birligini bog'lovchisiz saqlash
Parallel tuzilma bilan ro'yxat va qiyoslashni tekislash
Given -> new (ma'lumot oqimi) qoidasi bilan gaplarni ulash

content.bodyUz:
B1-B2 darslarida bizga «bog'lovchi ishlating» deb o'rgatishadi — va bu to'g'ri maslahat. Muammo shundaki, ko'pchilik shu yerda to'xtab qoladi.

Natija shunday matn bo'ladi:

*Moreover, cities are becoming crowded. Furthermore, house prices are rising. In addition, traffic is getting worse. However, some people like city life. Therefore, the problem is complex.*

Har bir gap bog'lovchi bilan boshlangan. Baholovchi buni **formulaic** deb belgilaydi va Coherence bali B2 da qoladi. Sababi C1 tavsifida aniq yozilgan: «uses cohesion in such a way that it **attracts no attention**».

Bog'lovchi — ko'rinadigan bog'lanish. C1 esa **ko'rinmaydigan** bog'lanishni talab qiladi. Uchta asosiy vosita bor: leksik zanjir, parallel tuzilma va ma'lumot oqimi.

**Amaliy norma:** 250 so'zli essede 4-5 ta bog'lovchi yetarli. Qolgan bog'lanish shu uchta vosita bilan ta'minlanadi.

Leksik zanjir — bir mavzuga oid so'zlarning matn bo'ylab uzluksiz tarqalishi. Ular bir-birini takrorlamaydi, lekin bir maydonga tegishli bo'lgani uchun o'quvchi mavzu o'zgarmaganini his qiladi.

*The **drought** has entered its third year. **Reservoirs** in the south are at a quarter of capacity, and **irrigation** quotas have been cut twice since spring. Farmers who once grew cotton are switching to crops that need less **water** — or leaving the land altogether.*

Zanjir: drought → reservoirs → irrigation → water. Birorta bog'lovchi yo'q, lekin matn mustahkam bog'langan.

**Qanday qurish kerak:** yozishdan oldin mavzuga oid 6-8 so'zni ro'yxat qiling. Masalan, ta'lim uchun: tuition, enrolment, curriculum, graduates, attainment, dropout rates, funding. Keyin ularni matn bo'ylab tarqating.

Bu bir vaqtda ikkita mezonga ishlaydi: **Cohesion** (bog'lanish) va **Lexical Resource** (so'z boyligi).

Bir xil mantiqiy maqomdagi elementlar bir xil grammatik shaklda bo'lishi kerak. Buzilsa — o'quvchi qoqiladi.

✗ *The scheme aims to reduce waste, improving recycling and to educate consumers.*
(uch xil shakl: reduce / improving / to educate)
✓ *The scheme aims **to reduce** waste, **to improve** recycling and **to educate** consumers.*

✗ *He was criticised for his arrogance and because he refused to listen.*
✓ *He was criticised for **his arrogance** and **his refusal to listen**.*

**Parallellik nafaqat tozalik uchun.** U qiyoslashni ham kuchaytiradi:

*The first policy **rewarded** investment; the second **punished** it.*
*Where the government **saw** an opportunity, the unions **saw** a threat.*

Bu — ritorik parallellik. Xulosa qismida bitta shunday gap butun essening taassurotini ko'taradi.

Bu qoida eng kam o'rgatiladigan, lekin eng kuchli ta'sir qiladigan vosita.

**Qoida:** har bir gap **tanish** ma'lumot bilan boshlanadi va **yangi** ma'lumot bilan tugaydi. Keyingi gap esa o'sha yangi ma'lumotni olib, uni tanish qiladi.

✗ **Yomon oqim:**
*A new metro line was opened in 2021. Congestion in the centre fell by 18%. Air quality also improved. The city council was praised for this.*
(Har bir gap noldan boshlanadi; o'quvchi bog'lanishni o'zi tiklashi kerak.)

✓ **Yaxshi oqim:**
*In 2021 the city opened a new metro line. **The line** now carries 400,000 passengers a day, a shift that has cut central congestion by 18%. **That reduction** has in turn improved air quality to a degree nobody predicted.*
(line → the line; cut congestion → that reduction. Har bir gap oldingisining oxiridan boshlanadi.)

**Amaliy natija:** gaplaringiz «Moreover» siz ham bog'langan bo'ladi. Bu — aynan «cohesion that attracts no attention».

rows: Moreover, house prices are rising. Furthermore, rents are rising too.
Housing costs have risen across the board: prices in the centre are up 12%, rents by nearly a fifth.
The plan aims to reduce waste. Moreover, it will improve recycling.
The plan aims to reduce waste, to improve recycling and to educate consumers.
A metro line opened in 2021. In addition, congestion fell by 18%.
In 2021 the city opened a metro line. The line now carries 400,000 passengers a day, cutting central congestion by 18%.
However, some people disagree. Nevertheless, the evidence is strong.
Critics dispute these figures. Their objection, however, rests on a single outdated study.
Firstly, it is expensive. Secondly, it is slow. Thirdly, it is unpopular.
The scheme is expensive, slow and — predictably — unpopular.
Therefore, the government must act. In conclusion, action is needed.
The case for intervention, then, is difficult to dismiss.
The drought continues. Also, there is not enough water.
The drought has entered its third year, and reservoirs in the south are at a quarter of capacity.
The first policy was good. The second policy was bad.
The first policy rewarded investment; the second punished it.

content.titleUz: Bitta xatboshi: bog'lovchisiz, lekin to'liq bog'langan

items.en: The drought has entered its third year. Reservoirs in the south are at a quarter of capacity, and irrigation quotas have been cut twice since spring. Farmers who once grew cotton are switching to crops that need far less water — or leaving the land altogether. That exodus is now visible in the census figures.
items.uz: Bitta ham «moreover», «furthermore», «in addition» yo'q. Bog'lanish leksik zanjir (drought-reservoirs-irrigation-water), given->new oqimi (leaving the land -> that exodus) va referencing orqali ta'minlangan. Bu — C1.

content.bodyUz:
**Baholash mezoni: Coherence and Cohesion — «uses cohesion in such a way that it attracts no attention» va «does not overuse cohesive devices».** Ikkinchi jumla ayniqsa muhim: bog'lovchini **ortiqcha ishlatish** alohida jazolanadi.

Imtihon tekshiruvi (1 daqiqa): essengizdagi gap boshidagi bog'lovchilarni sanang (Moreover, Furthermore, In addition, However, Therefore). Agar ular 5 tadan ko'p bo'lsa, yarmini o'chiring va o'rniga given -> new oqimini tiklang — ya'ni keyingi gapni oldingisining oxirgi tushunchasidan boshlang. Matn qisqarmaydi, lekin daraja ko'tariladi.

options: The line now carries 400,000 passengers a day, cutting central congestion by nearly a fifth.

In addition, the city council received a national award.
Furthermore, traffic is a serious problem in many countries.

exercises.explanationUz: Ikkinchi gap birinchisining OXIRGI tushunchasidan («a new metro line» -> «The line») boshlanadi va yangi ma'lumot bilan tugaydi. Qolgan uchtasi bog'lovchi qo'shadi, lekin mantiqiy ko'prik qurmaydi.

exercises.explanationUz: Ro'yxatdagi uch element uch xil shaklda: «to reduce» (infinitiv), «improving» (gerundiy), «to educate» (infinitiv). Bir xil maqomdagi elementlar bir xil grammatik shaklda bo'lishi shart.

exercises.explanationUz: rents, affordability, tenants — uy-joy maydoniga tegishli va zanjirni davom ettiradi. Photosynthesis va harvest boshqa maydonga tegishli; ular zanjirni uzadi va o'quvchini chalg'itadi.

items: That reduction has in turn improved air quality to a degree few analysts predicted.
In 2021 the city opened a new metro line.
The line now carries 400,000 passengers a day, a shift that has cut central congestion by 18%.

exercises.explanationUz: Zanjir: «a new metro line» -> «The line»; «cut congestion» -> «That reduction»; «improved air quality» -> «Such gains». Har bir gap oldingisining oxirida paydo bo'lgan tushunchadan boshlanadi.

data.text: The programme was designed to raise standards, ___ reduce inequality and to widen access.

exercises.explanationUz: Ro'yxatdagi uchala element ham «to + fe'l» shaklida bo'lishi kerak: to raise, to reduce, to widen. Bitta «to» ni tushirib qoldirish parallellikni buzadi va o'quvchini qoqiltiradi.
